case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Your labour and metal cost figures show genuine increases, and we recognise that sustainable pricing matters for continued supply. Thank you for explaining their cost shares and for your past support on pricing.

By the figures you gave us - LCI-C +2.7% at 30% of your cost, PPI-C241 +6.5% at 24% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +2.4%, not the 9.5% you ask for. German producer prices for electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

Our options recognise rising input costs while leaving room to distinguish current inflation from recovery of earlier underpricing. We are flexible on payment terms so you can choose the price and payment combination that works best for your foundry.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 131.90 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 131.97 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

Which cost elements of this part have actually risen since our last price agreement?

We value our long-standing relationship and want to keep it on a sound commercial footing.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We appreciate your detailed review of our indices and acknowledge the recent easing in electricity costs, which we have incorporated into our revised calculation.

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. While your analysis covers our primary materials and labour, it does not account for the substantial increases in our general operational and maintenance expenses over the same period. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

To maintain the reliable, high-quality supply you expect from our foundry, we propose a revised price of €135.50 per unit under your preferred 30-day payment terms. Our current Angebot is a price of €135.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for lowering your offer and incorporating the easing in electricity costs. We recognise that operational and maintenance expenses also matter, and that current indices alone cannot settle the question of recovering past underpricing.

We have modestly improved our price offer and are flexible on payment terms; please tell us which package suits you best. Option B retains the payment terms in your revised offer in exchange for a further price concession, while the other options offer a higher price for longer payment.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 133.60 per unit, payment 90 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 133.07 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option C: EUR 133.40 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

We appreciate your past support and want this agreement to sustain the relationship you have helped build.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for lowering your price again and confirming your preferred payment terms. Our reference to past underpricing came from an uncertain internal estimate, not verified evidence about your margins; you are right to challenge it, and we respect that your calculation remains internal.

We are making a modest further concession and are flexible on the effective date while retaining your chosen payment terms. Option B accepts your requested effective date in exchange for a lower price; the other options offer higher prices for later starts, so please tell us which works best.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 138.76 per unit, new price from 2027-04-01, payment 30 days net.
Option B: EUR 133.70 per unit, new price from 2026-11-01, payment 30 days net.
Option C: EUR 135.14 per unit, new price from 2027-01-01, payment 30 days net.

We appreciate your past support and want to reach a lasting agreement that honours our long-standing relationship.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your honesty regarding the internal estimate and respect your transparent approach. For our part, we have already taken that index change data into account.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €135.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

However, we prefer to maintain the effective date of 1 November 2026 to reflect our current cost realities. To bring us closer to an agreement, we are prepared to lower our price to €134.10 per unit under these terms.

Alternatively, at our standard terms with valid from 1 November 2026: a price of €134.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Alternatively, with valid from 1 November 2026: €134.10 per unit.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
